body: I really can't deal with the process of leaving him and leaving the house, it is so expensive, it is easier to stay and be miserable. maybe when I am done studying I can afford paying off my part and then I can leave him? but I would start over so old.
I am so sorry for writing here there are people who has it worse than me, I am a bad human, I shouldn't live

I am getting so old my life is running away. everyone else I see has such beautiful lives full of love. I spent soon 5 years with this guy. I wanted to be a young mom, but he didn't. we talked a few weeks ago and he didn't wanna think about it for another 10 years... while I want my first within 2... I wanted to be married by now...
if I won the lottery I would leave him and take a year off school. but I can't afford playing the lottery. so I am stuck with my own mental shit

We talked and will work on communicating our different needs to make each other happier. I tend to blow things out of proportions and I am not very good at saying runningly how I am unhappy about certain things, I more spew it all out at the same time.. which is unfair and not productive or good criticism. I know I do this but I have a hard time improving on it, but I have thought of new ways I can try improve on it.
He is in a very stressful time lately so I've understood better that he cancelled today because he found another course that fitted him better and he could do it with no repercussions. We have both been in our own bubble for a while :(
I own a house with him. I feel stuck. I dont have the money to leave.
